items.difficulty_reason: 34 行、三段式：①dual perfect complex 引理把 Ext 归到张量积上同调，induction principle 定框架；②仿射情形：affine-compare + perfect-affine + more-algebra perfect 定义把 E 写成有限项有限投射模复形 P^bullet，张量积由双复形全复形表示，对 P^bullet 长度归纳后只需 H^i(P^a ⊗ K^bullet) 可数——P^a 是 A^{⊕n} 的直和项 ⇒ 由 H^i(K^bullet) 可数得；③Mayer-Vietoris 正合列把并集情形从 V、W、V∩W 粘出来。可数性论证承重在 span 内；7 处引用（3 同章、4 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-countable-cohomology (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 8507-8519

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the reduction from Ext to cohomology of the tensor product by duality of perfect complexes, the affine case where the statement becomes countability of cohomology of a tensor product of module complexes handled by induction on the length of the finite projective complex, and the gluing step by the unbounded Mayer-Vietoris sequence (source lines 8521-8554)
